g.text: Epistemic Authority Firewall & Reified Claim Ledger
Statutory Tiers vs Marketing Claims | Anti-Conflation Barriers (CQ-74/75) | Reified RDF Statements with Provenance
Axiom: Tier 3 NEVER overrides Tier 1 / Tier 2
If a vendor claims "TRL 9 in Navy production"
in a whitepaper, but contract awards show only
Phase I SBIR, the firewall rejects the override.
Accounting ledgers, indirect rate audits, and
DCAA billing history cannot be substituted for
Prevents financial health from faking technical maturity
Triples lifted to verifiable graph nodes:
Every assertion is permanently traceable to exact source
